draw_agent_on_image: draw a rotated agent sprite onto a numpy image at specified center coordinates and radius
pointnav_draw_target_birdseye_view: create a birdseye view image showing agent position relative to a goal with colored distance bands
get_topdown_map: generate a top-down occupancy map from a pathfinder with optional border drawing and custom resolution
colorize_topdown_map: convert a grayscale top-down map to RGB using indicator values with optional fog of war masking
colorize_draw_agent_and_fit_to_height: colorize a top-down map, draw agents on it, and resize to a specified output height
